verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents a public v2 REST API covering the core scheduling surface: creating, rescheduling and instant bookings, slot availability, event types, schedules, conferencing apps, webhooks and routing traces. Authentication via API key or OAuth, Bearer headers, key prefixes and rate limits are all documented, and a dedicated agents page describes driving the API from AI agents (including a public booking endpoint). Probes confirm the docs are live as fetchable markdown. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed openapi/swagger paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
